inputs.name: hand over from Orchestration to Model Serving Endpoint

output.level_0: Orchestration crashes before reaching the endpoint, leaving the model completely unavailable to users.
output.level_1: No connection exists between orchestration and serving, so the model never reaches production.
output.level_2: Engineers manually copy model artifacts to the serving endpoint after each orchestration run.
output.level_3: Orchestration automatically triggers deployment to the model serving endpoint upon successful training.
output.level_4: Governed pipelines validate and log every handover to the serving endpoint for compliance.
